summary: Fixed Part I 6A-6C and 7A-7C name/address shrink-to-fit and border padding, Page 2 Taxpayer's Name comb-tick strike-through, Part III/Part II leaked internal JSON fixture paths, and Schedule 2/3 'add-more subtotal' jargon. Remaining items require shared crate/UI changes (TIN dash formatting in 6A-7C, Schedule 2 No. of Shares formatting/alignment, and 5-digit TIN branch-code box width).

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 6A-6C and 7A-7C (Seller's/Buyer's Name and Registered Address)
defects.what: Long names/addresses clipped or sat flush against cell borders because print-overrides/1707-2021.css forced hardcoded font-size:6.3px/5.2px !important over bir-print's dynamic shrink-to-fit and cells lacked horizontal padding.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 6A-6C and 7A-7C (Seller's/Buyer's TIN)
defects.what: TINs print as unformatted 14-digit strings (e.g. '00012345300000') without dashes.
Long Taxpayer's Name (>26 chars) fell back to plain proportional text rendered over visible vertical comb ticks.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 2 (Continuation), No. of Shares column
defects.what: Empty/zero rows print '0.00' left-aligned in integer comb slots (one char per tick).

defects.where: Part II (Tax Agent note) and Part III (Details of Payment Items 20-23)
defects.what: User-facing notes leaked internal repository path 'rules/forms/1707-v2021/fixtures/runtime-control-inventory-v796.json: disabled at load'.
Used internal jargon 'Schedule 2/3 add-more subtotal' instead of clear user-facing 'Schedule 2/3 additional rows subtotal'.

defects.where: Part I, Seller's/Buyer's TIN branch code input

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print or crates/bir-core: format 6A-6C and 7A-7C TINs with dashes (XXX-XXX-XXX-XXXXX) and format Schedule 2 No. of Shares as right-aligned integer without '.00'.
nsh/screens/form/: widen the 5-digit branch-code TIN box so '00000' does not clip.

html_frozen_upstream_edits.reason: Plain text inputs in Part I Items 6A-6C (Sellers) and 7A-7C (Buyers) name, address, and TIN cells have padding:0 from .fi and otherwise collide with the left cell border.

upstream_buwiz_forms_html.generator_rule: tools/formgen/emit.py: field_css_rules() (~line 4829, .fi currently emits padding:0) or field_input_markup() (~line 4739, slot_index is None plain-field branch)

non_html_frozen_print_edits.change: Removed hardcoded !important font-size overrides on #p1c25-i..#p1c49-i so bir-print dynamic shrink-to-fit sizes long seller/buyer names and addresses.
